source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 3 exercise solved (PDF 71-74), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Circular and Rotational Motion) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai; short sawalon ke chhote jawab, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke poore model jawab, aur numericals step by step (Given, formula, values, jawab) hal kiye gaye hain. Jahan kitab mein ghalti hai wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai, aur mushkil jagah "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
3.1 The ratio of angular speed of minute's hand and hour's hand of watch is:
(Ghari ki minute wali sui aur ghante wali sui ki angular speed (zaviyai raftar) ka tanasub kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Minute wali sui 60 min mein ek chakkar aur ghante wali sui 12 h = 720 min mein ek chakkar lagati hai. ω = 2π/T, is liye ω(minute) : ω(hour) = 720 : 60 = 12 : 1.

blocks.prompt:
3.2 A body travelling in a circle at constant speed:
(Circle mein constant speed se chalne wala jism:)

options.text: andar (centre ki taraf) radial acceleration rakhta hai
bahar ki taraf radial acceleration rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: Speed constant hai lekin velocity ki direction har point par badalti hai, is liye is ki centripetal acceleration a = v²/r centre ki taraf (andar) hoti hai (3.2).

blocks.prompt:
3.3 A stone at the end of long string is whirled in vertical circle at a constant speed. The tension in the string will be minimum when the stone is:
(Lambi string ke sire par bandha pathar vertical circle mein constant speed se ghumaya jata hai. String mein tension (khinchao) kab sab se kam hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Top par weight mg aur tension T dono centre ki taraf hain: T + mg = mv²/r, to T = mv²/r − mg (sab se kam). Bottom par T = mv²/r + mg (sab se zyada).

blocks.prompt:
3.4 Every point of rotating rigid body has:
(Ghoomte hue rigid body (sakht jism) ke har point ki kya cheez barabar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fixed axis ke gird ghoomte rigid body ke tamam points ki angular displacement, angular velocity aur angular acceleration ek jaisi hoti hai; linear velocity v = rω, r par depend karti hai (3.1).

blocks.prompt:
3.5 The minimum velocity necessary to put a satellite into the orbit is called:
(Satellite ko orbit (madaar) mein dalne ke liye kam se kam zaroori velocity ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: v = √(gR) = 7.9 km s⁻¹ woh kam se kam velocity hai jis se satellite orbit mein jata hai; ise critical velocity kehte hain (3.3).

blocks.prompt:
3.6 An astronaut is orbiting around the Earth in a large capsule. Then,
(Ek astronaut bare capsule mein Earth ke gird orbit kar raha hai. To,)

options.text: woh capsule ke lehaz se weightlessness (be-wazni) ki halat mein hoga
woh Earth ki taraf free fall kar raha hai
us ko angle par phenki gayi ball seedhi line mein jati nazar aati hai

blocks.explanation: Capsule aur astronaut dono ek hi acceleration g se Earth ki taraf free fall kar rahe hain, is liye supporting force zero hai (be-wazni). Capsule ke andar koi cheez neeche nahi girti, is liye phenki gayi ball usay seedhi line mein jati dikhti hai. Teenon baatein sahi hain.

blocks.prompt:
3.7 An object in uniform circular motion makes 10 revolutions in 2 seconds. Which of the following statement is true?
(Uniform circular motion mein ek cheez 2 second mein 10 chakkar lagati hai. Kaun si baat sahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: f = 10 chakkar ÷ 2 s = 5 Hz, aur T = 1/f = 0.2 s.

blocks.prompt:
3.8 A man inside the artificial satellite feels weightlessness because the force of attraction due to the Earth is:
(Artificial satellite ke andar aadmi be-wazni kyun mehsoos karta hai? Kyunke Earth ki kashish (attraction) ki force:)

options.text: moon ki kashish se balance ho jati hai
satellite ke khaas design ki wajah se be-asar hai

blocks.explanation: Gravity ki poori force mg centripetal force mv²/r ban kar kharch hoti hai, is liye mg = mg − F_N se F_N = 0 aata hai (3.3).

blocks.prompt:
3.9 A bottle of soda water is grasped from the neck and swung briskly in a vertical circle. Near which portion of the bottle do the bubbles collect?
(Soda water ki botal gardan (neck) se pakar kar tezi se vertical circle mein ghumai jati hai. Bulbule (bubbles) botal ke kis hissay ke qareeb jama honge?)

options.text: Bulbule poori botal mein phaile rehte hain

blocks.explanation: Gardan rotation ke axis ke qareeb hai. Centrifuge ki tarah bhaari liquid bahar (botal ke bottom ki taraf) jata hai aur halke bulbule axis ke qareeb, yani gardan ke paas jama hote hain (3.2).

blocks.prompt:
3.10 The moment of inertia of body depends upon:
(Jism ka moment of inertia kis cheez par depend karta hai?)

options.text: jism ki mass aur axis of rotation ke gird us ki taqseem (distribution)

blocks.explanation: I = Σ mᵢrᵢ²: yeh mass par aur is baat par depend karta hai ke mass axis of rotation se kitni door kaise phaili hai (3.4).

blocks.prompt:
3.1 State second law of motion in case of rotation.
Rotation ke liye Newton ka second law bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ghoomte rigid body par lagne wala torque us ke moment of inertia aur angular acceleration ke product ke barabar hota hai: τ = Iα.
Yeh F = ma ka rotational roop hai (F ki jagah τ, m ki jagah I, a ki jagah α).

blocks.prompt:
3.2 What is the effect of changing the position of a diver while diving in the pool?
Pool mein dive karte waqt diver apni position badle to kya asar hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Baazu aur taangein andar samet kar diver apna moment of inertia kam karta hai, to angular velocity barh jati hai (Iω = constant) aur woh zyada qalabaziyan (somersaults) lagata hai.
Pani mein dakhil hone se pehle jism phaila kar I barhata hai, to ω kam ho jati hai aur woh aaram se pani mein jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.3 How do we get butter from the milk?
Doodh se makhan kaise hasil karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Doodh ko cream separator mein tezi se ghumaya (ya bilona) jata hai. Doodh mein halke aur bhaari zarrat hote hain: halke charbi (cream) ke zarray axis of rotation ke qareeb jama ho jate hain aur bhaari zarray bahar chale jate hain. Axis ke paas jama cream nikaal kar us se makhan banaya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.4 Mass is a measure of inertia in linear motion. What is its analogue in rotational motion? Describe briefly.
Linear motion mein mass inertia ka paimana hai. Rotational motion mein is ka mutabadil (analogue) kya hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Moment of inertia (I) mass ka rotational mutabadil hai. Yeh batata hai ke jism apni rotational motion ki tabdeeli ki kitni mukhalifat (resistance) karta hai.
I = Σ mᵢrᵢ²; yeh mass aur axis ke gird us ki taqseem par depend karta hai. Unit: kg m².

blocks.prompt:
3.5 Why is it harder for a car to take turn at higher speed than at lower speed?
Gaari ke liye tez speed par mor (turn) lena dheemi speed ke muqable mein mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Mor ke liye zaroori centripetal force F = mv²/r hai, jo v² ke saath barhti hai. Level road par yeh force tyres aur road ki friction deti hai jo mehdood (limited) hai. Tez speed par zaroori force friction se zyada ho jati hai, is liye gaari bahar ki taraf phisal (skid) jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.6 What are the benefits of using rare wheels of heavy vehicles consisted of double tires?
Bhaari gariyon ke pichhle (rear) pahiyon mein double tyres ke kya faide hain?
blocks.explanation:
Double tyres bhaari wazan ko baant lete hain, har tyre par kam bojh aur road par kam pressure aata hai.
Zyada contact area se zyada grip (friction) milti hai jo mor par zaroori centripetal force deti hai aur gaari mustahkam (stable) rehti hai; ek tyre phat jaye to doosra sahara deta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein "rare wheels" chhapa hai; is se muraad "rear wheels" (pichhle pahiye) hain. Ek axle par do do tyres lage hote hain, is liye bhaari truck aur bus ka bojh zyada tyres mein bant jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.7 When a moving car turns around a corner to the left, in what direction do the occupants tend to fall? Explain briefly.
Chalti gaari baayen (left) taraf mure to sawariyan kis taraf girne lagti hain? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Woh daayen (right) taraf, yani mor se bahar ki taraf girne lagti hain.
Inertia (jumood) ki wajah se un ke jism seedhi line mein chalte rehna chahte hain jab ke gaari left murti hai; seat aur friction unhein gaari ke saath morne ke liye centripetal force deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
3.8 Why is the acceleration of a body moving uniformly in a circle, directed towards the centre?
Circle mein uniform chalne wale jism ki acceleration centre ki taraf kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Uniform circular motion mein speed constant hai, sirf velocity ki direction badalti hai. Har point par velocity ki tabdeeli (Δv) radius ke saath centre ki taraf hoti hai, is liye acceleration a = v²/r (aur usay paida karne wali centripetal force) centre ki taraf hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.9 How does an astronaut feel weightlessness while orbiting from the Earth in a space-ship?
Space-ship mein Earth ke gird ghoomte hue astronaut be-wazni kaise mehsoos karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Space-ship aur astronaut dono ek hi acceleration g se Earth ki taraf free fall kar rahe hain; Earth ki kashish sirf centripetal force deti hai.
Is liye mv²/r = mg − F_N se F_N = 0: farsh us par koi supporting force nahi lagata, aur woh be-wazni mehsoos karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.1 If angular velocity of different particles of a rigid body is constant, will the linear velocity of these particles also constant?
Agar rigid body ke mukhtalif zarrat ki angular velocity constant ho to kya un ki linear velocity bhi constant hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Ghoomte rigid body ke tamam zarrat ki angular velocity ω ek jaisi hoti hai, lekin linear velocity v = rω hai.
Axis se door wale zarray (bara r) tez chalte hain, qareeb wale ahista, aur axis par mojood zarray ki v = 0 hai.
Is ke ilawa v ki direction (tangent ke saath) badalti rehti hai, is liye ek zarray ki linear velocity bhi direction mein constant nahi; ω constant ho to sirf us ki miqdaar (magnitude) constant rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.2 A loaf of bread is lying on rotating plate. A crow takes away the loaf of bread and the plates rotation increase. Why?
Ghoomti plate par roti pari hai. Kawwa roti utha le jata hai aur plate ki rotation tez ho jati hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh angular momentum ke conservation (bachao) ke qanoon ki wajah se hai.
Jab kawwa roti uthata hai (axis ke gird koi bairooni torque nahi), plate par mass kam ho jati hai, is liye ghoomte system ka moment of inertia I₁ se kam ho kar I₂ ho jata hai.
Chunkay I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂ aur I₂ < I₁, is liye ω₂, ω₁ se zyada ho jati hai; plate tez ghoomne lagti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.3 Why do we tumble when we take the sharp turn with large speed?
Tez speed par tez mor (sharp turn) lene par hum lurhak (tumble) kyun jate hain?
blocks.explanation:
Tez speed par tez mor (chhota r) mein zaroori centripetal force F = mv²/r bohat bari hoti hai.
Hamare paon friction se gaari ke saath mur jate hain, lekin jism ka upar wala hissa inertia ki wajah se seedha (mor se bahar ki taraf) chalta rehna chahta hai. Friction aur hamari pakar itni bari centripetal force nahi de sakti, is liye jism bahar jhukta hai aur hum lurhak jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3.4 What will be time period of a simple pendulum in an artificial satellite?
Artificial satellite mein simple pendulum ka time period kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Orbit karte satellite mein har cheez be-wazni ki halat mein hoti hai, is liye andar g ki mo'asir (effective) value zero hai.
T = 2π√(l/g) = 2π√(l/0) = infinite (la-mehdood).
Is liye pendulum jhoolta hi nahi; us ka time period infinite hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Simple pendulum ka formula T = 2π√(l/g) kitab ke is chapter mein nahi; yeh pichhli class se hai. Pendulum ko wapas laane wali force wazan (mg) se aati hai; satellite mein be-wazni hai, is liye wapas laane wali force hi nahi, aur pendulum jahan chhoro wahin ruka rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.5 Is the motion of a satellite in its orbit, uniform or accelerated?
Kya satellite ki apne orbit mein motion uniform hai ya accelerated?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh accelerated hai. Satellite (taqreeban) circular orbit mein constant speed se chalta hai, lekin har point par velocity ki direction badalti hai.
Earth ki kashish centripetal acceleration a = v²/r (us unchai par g ke barabar) Earth ke centre ki taraf deti hai. Is liye speed uniform hai lekin motion accelerated hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.6 What are the advantages that radian has been preferred as SI unit over degree?
Degree ke muqable mein radian ko SI unit kyun tarjeeh di gayi? Is ke faide kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Radian do lambaiyon ka tanasub hai (θ = S/r), is liye yeh qudrati unit hai jo circle ki marzi ki taqseem (jaise 360°) par depend nahi karti.
2. Saada rishte S = rθ, v = rω aur a = rα sirf radian mein sahi hain; degree mein izafi conversion factor lagana parta hai.
3. Is se angular quantities aur linear quantities ke rishte ke hisaab saada aur seedhe ho jate hain (1 rev = 2π rad, 1 rad = 57.3°).

blocks.prompt:
3.7 In uniform circular motion, what are the average velocity and average acceleration for one revolution? Explain.
Uniform circular motion mein ek chakkar (revolution) ki average velocity aur average acceleration kya hain? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono zero hain.
Average velocity = kul displacement ÷ waqt. Ek chakkar ke baad jism wapas shuru wale point par aa jata hai, is liye displacement = 0 aur average velocity = 0.
Average acceleration = velocity ki tabdeeli ÷ waqt = (v_f − v_i)/T. Ek chakkar ke baad velocity ki miqdaar aur direction wahi hoti hai jo shuru mein thi, is liye v_f − v_i = 0 aur average acceleration = 0.
(Har lamhe ki acceleration v²/r zero nahi; sirf poore chakkar ki average zero hai.)

blocks.prompt:
3.8 In a rainstorm with a strong wind, what determines the best position to hold an umbrella?
Tez hawa wale toofan-e-baarish mein chhatri pakarne ki behtareen position kis cheez se tay hoti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Baarish ki resultant (nisbati / relative) velocity ki direction is ko tay karti hai.
Qatron ki ek vertical velocity v_r (girna) hoti hai aur hawa unhein horizontal velocity v_w deti hai. In ka resultant vertical se θ angle banata hai, jahan tan θ = v_w / v_r.
Chhatri hawa ki taraf itni jhuka kar pakrein ke us ki dandi baarish ki is resultant direction mein ho (agar hum chal rahe hon to hamari apni velocity bhi baarish ki relative velocity mein shamil hoti hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: baarish 8 m s⁻¹ se seedhi gir rahi hai aur hawa 6 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. tan θ = 6/8 = 0.75, θ ≈ 37°. Chhatri hawa ki taraf vertical se taqreeban 37° jhuka kar pakrein.

blocks.prompt:
3.9 A ball is just supported by a string without breaking. If it is whirled in a vertical circle, it breaks. Explain why.
Ek ball string se latki hai aur string bas itni mazboot hai ke nahi toot-ti. Agar usay vertical circle mein ghumaya jaye to string toot jati hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation:
Jab ball aaram se latki ho to tension T = mg hota hai, aur string bas itna hi bardasht kar sakti hai.
Vertical circle mein ghumane par sab se neeche wale point par tension ko wazan bhi uthana hai aur centripetal force bhi deni hai:
T − mg = mv²/r, is liye T = mg + mv²/r.
Yeh tension mg se zyada hai, yani string ki bardasht se zyada, is liye string toot jati hai (aam taur par neeche wale point ke qareeb).

blocks.prompt:
3.10 How the centripetal force supplied in the following cases:
(a) A satellite orbiting around the Earth.
(b) A car taking a turn on a level road.
(c) A stone whirled in a circle by means of a string.
In suraton mein centripetal force kahan se milti hai?
blocks.explanation:
(a) Earth aur satellite ke darmiyan gravitational kashish ki force centripetal force deti hai: GMm/r² = mv²/r.
(b) Tyres aur level road ke darmiyan friction ki force centripetal force deti hai.
(c) String ka tension, jo pathar ko centre ki taraf kheenchta hai, centripetal force deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.1 What is meant by angular momentum? Explain the law of conservation of angular momentum with daily life examples.
Angular momentum se kya muraad hai? Angular momentum ke conservation ke qanoon ko rozmarra misalon se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Angular momentum:
Agar kisi zarray ki angular position kisi axis ke lehaz se badal rahi ho to us ke paas us axis ke gird angular momentum hota hai. Mass m aur momentum p = mv wale zarray ke liye jis ka position vector origin O se r hai:
L = r × p
Miqdaar: L = rp sin θ = mrv sin θ, jahan θ, r aur p ke darmiyan angle hai.
Direction: r aur p ke plane par perpendicular (amood), right hand rule se. SI unit: kg m² s⁻¹ (ya J s).
Circular motion mein θ = 90°, to L = mrv = mr²ω; rigid body ke liye L = Iω.

Angular momentum ke conservation ka qanoon:
Agar system par koi bairooni (external) torque na lage to system ka kul angular momentum constant rehta hai.
L_total = L₁ + L₂ + … = constant
Ek ghoomta jism agar apna moment of inertia I₁ se I₂ kar le to: I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂. I kam ho to ω barhti hai, aur I barhe to ω ghat-ti hai. Bairooni torque na ho to L ki direction (rotation ka axis) bhi qaim rehti hai.

Rozmarra misalein:
1. Diver: board chhorne ke baad baazu aur taangein samet leta hai, I kam, ω zyada, aur woh qalabaziyan lagata hai; pani ke qareeb jism phaila kar I barhata hai aur ω kam karta hai.
2. Ice skater: baazu samet kar aur phaili taang qareeb la kar I kam karta hai aur tez ghoomta hai; phaila kar ahista ho jata hai.
3. Turntable par dumb-bell pakre shakhs: haath andar laane se I kam aur angular speed foran zyada ho jati hai.
4. Cycle/bike: ghoomte pahiyon ka angular momentum tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai aur chalti bike ko seedha rakhta hai.
5. Sooraj ke gird chalte hue Earth ka axis ek hi direction mein rehta hai (koi bara torque nahi), jis se mausam bante hain; polar barf pighal kar equator ki taraf jaye to Earth ka I barhta hai aur angular velocity thori kam (din thora lamba) ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.2 Show that orbital angular momentum; L = Iω.
Sabit karein ke orbital angular momentum L = Iω hai.
blocks.explanation:
Ek zarray ke liye:
Mass m ka zarray radius r ke circle mein angular velocity ω se chal raha hai. Us ka momentum p = mv tangent ke saath hai, is liye r aur p ke darmiyan angle 90° hai.
L = rp sin 90° = mrv
Lekin v = rω, is liye L = mr²ω.
Zarray ke liye mr² = I (axis ke gird us ka moment of inertia), to L = Iω.

Rigid body ke liye:
Ek symmetric rigid body apne centre of mass se guzarte fixed axis ke gird ω se ghoom raha hai. Yeh zarrat m₁, m₂, …, mₙ se bana hai jo axis se r₁, r₂, …, rₙ faasle par hain; sab ek hi ω se circle mein chalte hain.
iᵗʰ zarray ka angular momentum: Lᵢ = mᵢvᵢrᵢ = mᵢrᵢ²ω (kyunke vᵢ = rᵢω), axis ke saath.
Kul angular momentum:
L = m₁r₁²ω + m₂r₂²ω + … + mₙrₙ²ω = (Σ mᵢrᵢ²) ω
Chunkay Σ mᵢrᵢ² = I (axis ke gird jism ka moment of inertia):
L = Iω (vector mein L⃗ = Iω⃗, rotation ke axis ke saath).

blocks.prompt:
3.3 Define moment of inertia. Prove that torque acting on rotating rigid body is equal to the product of its moment of inertia and angular momentum.
Moment of inertia ki tareef karein. Sabit karein ke ghoomte rigid body par torque us ke moment of inertia aur angular acceleration ke product ke barabar hai.
blocks.explanation:
Moment of inertia:
Kisi axis ke gird jism ka moment of inertia har zarray ki mass aur axis se us ke perpendicular faasle ke square ke product ka majmooa hai: I = Σ mᵢrᵢ². Rotational motion mein yeh wahi kirdar ada karta hai jo linear motion mein mass. Unit: kg m².

Saboot (τ = Iα):
Ek zarray: mass m ek massless rod (lambai r) ke sire par hai jo O par pivot hai; rod par perpendicular force F lagti hai.
F = ma_T, aur a_T = rα, to F = mrα.
Dono taraf r se zarb dein: rF = mr²α, yani τ = mr²α.
Rigid body: jism zarrat m₁, m₂, …, mₙ se bana hai jo axis se r₁, r₂, …, rₙ par hain. Har ek par torque: τ₁ = m₁r₁²α, τ₂ = m₂r₂²α, …, τₙ = mₙrₙ²α. Jism sakht (rigid) hai, is liye sab ki angular acceleration α ek hai.
τ_total = (m₁r₁² + m₂r₂² + … + mₙrₙ²) α = (Σ mᵢrᵢ²) α
τ = Iα
Yani ghoomte rigid body par torque us ke moment of inertia aur angular acceleration ke product ke barabar hai (F = ma ka rotational roop).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "moment of inertia aur angular momentum ka product" chhapa hai. Torque moment of inertia aur angular ACCELERATION ka product hai (τ = Iα, Eq. 3.18); I × angular momentum torque nahi banta. Jawab mein τ = Iα sabit kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.4 What are artificial satellites? Calculate the minimum time period necessary to put a satellite into the orbit.
Artificial satellites kya hain? Satellite ko orbit mein dalne ke liye kam se kam time period hisaab karein.
blocks.explanation:
Artificial satellites:
Satellites woh cheezein hain jo Earth ke gird taqreeban circular raste mein ghoomti hain. Artificial satellites insaan ke banaye hue hain; rockets inhein orbit mein dalte hain aur Earth ki gravitational kashish (jo centripetal force deti hai) inhein orbit mein rakhti hai. Yeh communication, mausam ki khabar, GPS waghera ke liye istemal hote hain.

Kam se kam period (Earth ki satah ke qareeb orbit):
Neechi orbit ke liye centripetal acceleration g hai: g = v²/R
v = √(gR) = √(9.8 m s⁻² × 6.4 × 10⁶ m) = 7.9 × 10³ m s⁻¹ = 7.9 km s⁻¹
Yeh satellite ko orbit mein dalne ki critical (kam se kam) velocity hai.
Time period: T = 2πR/v = 2π√(R/g)
T = 2 × 3.14 × 6.4 × 10⁶ m ÷ 7.9 × 10³ m s⁻¹
T ≈ 5.08 × 10³ s ≈ 85 min (kitab 5060 s ≈ 84 min likhti hai)
Unchai par satellite ko kam speed chahiye aur ek chakkar mein zyada waqt lagta hai, is liye yeh kam se kam period hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.5 Define orbital velocity. Derive an expression for the same.
Orbital velocity ki tareef karein aur us ka formula derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Orbital velocity:
Jis velocity se satellite apne orbit mein Earth ke gird ghoomta hai use orbital velocity kehte hain.

Derivation:
Maan lein mass mₛ ka satellite, mass M wali Earth ke gird radius r ke circular orbit mein speed v se ghoom raha hai.
Zaroori centripetal force: F_c = mₛv²/r
Yeh force gravitational force deti hai: F_g = Gmₛ M/r²
Barabar karne se: Gmₛ M/r² = mₛv²/r
v² = GM/r
v = √(GM/r)   (Eq. 3.15)
Orbital velocity satellite ki mass par depend nahi karti; sirf Earth ki mass aur orbit ke radius par (unchi orbit ko kam speed chahiye).
Earth ki satah ke qareeb (r ≈ R, GM/R² = g): v = √(gR) = √(9.8 × 6.4 × 10⁶) ≈ 7.9 km s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
3.6 Write a note on artificial gravity. Derive an expression for frequency with which the spaceship rotates to provide artificial gravity.
Artificial gravity par note likhein. Spaceship ko artificial gravity dene ke liye jis frequency se ghumana hai us ka formula derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Artificial gravity:
Gravity se khaali space (orbit karte spaceship) mein koi force jism ko spacecraft ki kisi taraf nahi dhakelti. Lambe arse tak yeh be-wazni astronauts ki sehat aur kaam par asar karti hai. Is ka hal yeh hai ke spaceship ko apne axis ke gird ghumaya jaye. Phir bahar wali deewar (farsh) astronauts ko dhakelti hai aur centripetal force deti hai; yeh dhakka unhein wazan jaisa mehsoos hota hai. Gravity jaise is asar ko artificial (masnooi) gravity kehte hain.

Derivation:
Spaceship ka bahar wala radius R hai aur yeh angular speed ω se ghoomta hai. Kinare (rim) ke point ki centripetal acceleration:
a_c = Rω²
ω = 2π/t (t = ek chakkar ka waqt), to a_c = R(2π)²/t² = 4π²R/t²
f = 1/t se: a_c = 4π²Rf²
f² = a_c/(4π²R), f = (1/2π)√(a_c/R)
Earth jaisi gravity ke liye a_c = g:
f = (1/2π)√(g/R)   (Eq. 3.17)
Is frequency se ghoomne par andar walon ko Earth jitni artificial gravity mehsoos hoti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan misal: baalti ko tezi se ghumayein to pani baalti ke farsh se chipka rehta hai, kyunke baalti ka farsh pani ko centre ki taraf dhakelta hai. Ghoomte spaceship mein astronaut ke saath bhi yahi hota hai; farsh ka dhakka usay wazan jaisa lagta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.7 Prove that; (i) v = rω and (ii) a = rα
Sabit karein: (i) v = rω aur (ii) a = rα
blocks.explanation:
Ek rigid body z-axis ke gird ghoom raha hai. Point P axis se perpendicular faasla r par hai; OP reference line hai.

(i) v = rω
Chhote waqt Δt mein P arc P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai jab ke OP angle Δθ (radian mein) ghoomti hai. S = rθ se:
ΔS = r Δθ
Δt se taqseem: ΔS/Δt = r (Δθ/Δt)
Δt → 0 ki had mein ΔS/Δt = v (P ki linear speed, tangent ke saath) aur Δθ/Δt = ω (OP ki angular velocity):
v = rω   (Eq. 3.7)

(ii) a = rα
Agar Δt mein angular velocity ωᵢ se ω_f ho jaye to linear velocity vᵢ = rωᵢ se v_f = rω_f ho jati hai:
Δv = v_f − vᵢ = r(ω_f − ωᵢ) = r Δω
Δt se taqseem: Δv/Δt = r (Δω/Δt)
Δt → 0 ki had mein Δv/Δt = a_t (tangential acceleration) aur Δω/Δt = α (angular acceleration):
a_t = rα   (Eq. 3.8)
Is se pata chalta hai ke axis se door points ki linear speed aur acceleration zyada hai, jab ke sab ki ω aur α ek jaisi hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.1 A laser beam is directed from the Earth to the moon. The beam spreads over a diameter of 2.50 cm at the moon surface, What is divergence angle of the beam? The distance of moon from the Earth is 3.8 × 10⁸ m. (Ans: 6.6 × 10^? rad, exponent not legible in the print)
Laser beam Earth se moon ki taraf bheji jati hai. Moon ki satah par beam 2.50 cm diameter mein phail jati hai. Beam ka divergence angle kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: moon par spot ka diameter S = 2.50 cm = 0.025 m; moon ka faasla r = 3.8 × 10⁸ m
Required: divergence angle θ = ?
Spot radius r wale circle ka bohat chhota arc hai, is liye S = rθ:
θ = S/r
θ = 0.025 m ÷ 3.8 × 10⁸ m
θ = 6.6 × 10⁻¹¹ rad

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke jawab mein 10 ki power saaf parhi nahi jati. 0.025 m ÷ 3.8 × 10⁸ m = 6.58 × 10⁻¹¹ rad, is liye jawab 6.6 × 10⁻¹¹ rad hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.2 A car is moving with a speed of 108 km h⁻¹. If its wheel has a diameter of 60 cm, find its angular speed in rad s⁻¹ and rev s⁻¹. (Ans: 100 rad s⁻¹, 16 rev s⁻¹)
Gaari 108 km h⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Pahiye ka diameter 60 cm hai. Angular speed rad s⁻¹ aur rev s⁻¹ mein maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: v = 108 km h⁻¹ = 108 × 1000 m ÷ 3600 s = 30 m s⁻¹
Diameter = 60 cm, is liye r = 30 cm = 0.30 m
Required: ω = ? (rad s⁻¹ aur rev s⁻¹ mein)
v = rω, to ω = v/r
ω = 30 m s⁻¹ ÷ 0.30 m
ω = 100 rad s⁻¹
rev s⁻¹ mein (1 rev = 2π rad):
f = ω/2π = 100 ÷ (2 × 3.14) = 15.9 rev s⁻¹ ≈ 16 rev s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
3.3 An electric motor is running at 1800 rev min⁻¹. On switching OFF it comes to rest in 20 s. If angular retardation is uniform, find the number of revolutions it makes before stopping. (Ans: 300 rev)
Electric motor 1800 rev min⁻¹ par chal rahi hai. Band karne par 20 s mein ruk jati hai. Uniform retardation ho to rukne se pehle kitne chakkar lagati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: ωᵢ = 1800 rev min⁻¹ = 1800 ÷ 60 = 30 rev s⁻¹; ω_f = 0; t = 20 s
Required: chakkar θ = ?
α = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/t = (0 − 30 rev s⁻¹) ÷ 20 s = −1.5 rev s⁻²
θ = ωᵢt + ½αt²
θ = 30 rev s⁻¹ × 20 s + ½ × (−1.5 rev s⁻²) × (20 s)²
θ = 600 rev − 300 rev
θ = 300 rev
(Check: θ = average ω × t = (30 + 0)/2 × 20 = 300 rev.)

blocks.prompt:
3.4 A string 0.5 m long holding a stone can withstand maximum tension of 35.6 N. Find the maximum speed at which a stone of 0.5 kg can be whirled with it in a vertical circle. (Ans: 5.5 m s⁻¹)
0.5 m lambi string zyada se zyada 35.6 N tension bardasht kar sakti hai. 0.5 kg ke pathar ko vertical circle mein kis zyada se zyada speed se ghumaya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: r = 0.5 m; T_max = 35.6 N; m = 0.5 kg; g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Required: zyada se zyada speed v = ?
Vertical circle mein tension sab se neeche wale point par sab se zyada hota hai, jahan yeh wazan bhi uthata hai aur centripetal force bhi deta hai:
T − mg = mv²/r, to T = mg + mv²/r
35.6 N = 0.5 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² + 0.5 kg × v² ÷ 0.5 m
35.6 = 4.9 + v²
v² = 30.7 m² s⁻²
v = 5.54 m s⁻¹ ≈ 5.5 m s⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: String sab se zyada neeche wale point par toot-ti hai, kyunke wahan tension ko wazan (mg) aur centripetal force (mv²/r) dono dene parte hain. Is liye zyada se zyada speed neeche wale point ke tension se nikalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3.5 The flywheel of an engine is rotating at 2100 rev min⁻¹ when the power source is shut off. What torque is required to stop it in 3 minutes? The moment of inertia of the flywheel is 36 kg m². (Ans: 44 N m)
Engine ka flywheel 2100 rev min⁻¹ par ghoom raha hai jab power band ki jati hai. Usay 3 minute mein rokne ke liye kitna torque chahiye? Moment of inertia 36 kg m² hai.
blocks.explanation:
Given: ωᵢ = 2100 rev min⁻¹ = 2100 × 2π rad ÷ 60 s = 70π rad s⁻¹ = 219.9 rad s⁻¹; ω_f = 0
t = 3 min = 180 s; I = 36 kg m²
Required: torque τ = ?
α = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/t = (0 − 219.9 rad s⁻¹) ÷ 180 s = −1.22 rad s⁻²
τ = Iα
τ = 36 kg m² × 1.22 rad s⁻² (miqdaar)
τ = 44 N m (rotation ke ulat lagta hai)

blocks.prompt:
3.6 What is the moment of inertia of a 200 kg sphere whose diameter is 60 cm. (Ans: 28.8 kg m²)
200 kg ke sphere (gola) ka moment of inertia kya hai jis ka diameter 60 cm hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: M = 200 kg; diameter = 60 cm, is liye radius r = 30 cm = 0.30 m
Required: moment of inertia I = ?
Solid sphere ke liye (section 3.4 mein mukhtalif ajsam ke moment of inertia: diameter 2r wala sphere): I = (2/5) Mr²
I = 2/5 × 200 kg × (0.30 m)²
I = 0.4 × 200 × 0.09 kg m²
I = 7.2 kg m²

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (Ans: 28.8 kg m²) likhti hai. Yeh jawab radius ki jagah diameter (0.60 m) rakhne se aata hai: 2/5 × 200 × (0.60)² = 28.8. Chapter ka formula I = (2/5)Mr² radius r = 0.30 m leta hai, is liye sahi jawab I = 7.2 kg m² hai.

blocks.prompt:
3.7 A satellite is orbiting the Earth at an altitude of 200 km. Assuming the Earth's radius is 6400 km, calculate the orbital speed of the satellite. (Ans: 7.78 km h⁻¹)
Satellite Earth se 200 km ki unchai par ghoom raha hai. Earth ka radius 6400 km maan kar satellite ki orbital speed maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: h = 200 km; R = 6400 km
Orbit ka radius r = R + h = 6600 km = 6.6 × 10⁶ m
G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²; Earth ki mass M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg
Required: orbital speed v = ?
v = √(GM/r)   (Eq. 3.15)
v = √(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 6.0 × 10²⁴ ÷ 6.6 × 10⁶) m s⁻¹
v = √(6.06 × 10⁷) m s⁻¹
v = 7.79 × 10³ m s⁻¹ ≈ 7.8 km s⁻¹ (G aur M ki thori mukhtalif rounding se 7.78 km s⁻¹)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab 7.78 km h⁻¹ likhti hai. Number theek hai lekin unit ghalat hai: orbital speed 7.78 km s⁻¹ (kilometre per second) hai, yani taqreeban 28 000 km h⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
3.8 A space station has a radius of 20 m and rotates at an angular velocity of 0.5 rad s⁻¹. What is the artificial gravity experienced by the astronauts on the space station. (Ans: 5 m s⁻²)
Space station ka radius 20 m hai aur yeh 0.5 rad s⁻¹ se ghoomta hai. Astronauts kitni artificial gravity mehsoos karenge?
blocks.explanation:
Given: R = 20 m; ω = 0.5 rad s⁻¹
Required: artificial gravity a_c = ?
a_c = Rω²
a_c = 20 m × (0.5 rad s⁻¹)²
a_c = 20 × 0.25 m s⁻²
a_c = 5 m s⁻² (g ka taqreeban aadha)

blocks.prompt:
3.9 A bicycle wheel has an angular momentum of 10 kg m² s⁻¹ and angular velocity of 2 rad s⁻¹. Find the value of its moment of inertial. (Ans: 5 kg m²)
Cycle ke pahiye ka angular momentum 10 kg m² s⁻¹ aur angular velocity 2 rad s⁻¹ hai. Us ka moment of inertia maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: L = 10 kg m² s⁻¹; ω = 2 rad s⁻¹
Required: I = ?
L = Iω, to I = L/ω
I = 10 kg m² s⁻¹ ÷ 2 rad s⁻¹
I = 5 kg m²

blocks.prompt:
3.10 A diver comes off a board with arms straight up and legs straight down, giving him a moment of inertia of 18 kg m² about his rotation axis. Then tucks into a small ball, decreasing his moment of inertia to 3.6 kg m². While tucked, he makes two complete rotations in 1.0 second. If he had not tucked at all, how many revolutions would he have made in 1.5 s from board to water? (Ans: 0.6 rev)
Diver baazu seedhe upar aur taangein seedhi neeche rakh kar board chhorta hai (I₁ = 18 kg m²). Phir sikur kar gola ban jata hai (I₂ = 3.6 kg m²) aur 1.0 s mein 2 poore chakkar lagata hai. Agar woh bilkul na sikurta to board se pani tak 1.5 s mein kitne chakkar lagata?
blocks.explanation:
Given: I₁ (seedha) = 18 kg m²; I₂ (sikra hua) = 3.6 kg m²
ω₂ (sikra hua) = 2 rev ÷ 1.0 s = 2 rev s⁻¹; t = 1.5 s
Required: na sikurne par 1.5 s mein chakkar = ?
Angular momentum ke conservation se: I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂
ω₁ = I₂ω₂/I₁ = 3.6 kg m² × 2 rev s⁻¹ ÷ 18 kg m²
ω₁ = 0.4 rev s⁻¹
Chakkar = ω₁ × t = 0.4 rev s⁻¹ × 1.5 s
= 0.6 rev
